description: Writes and reviews concise executable engineering plans that reuse canonical PRD product authority when available, fall back to a protected local decision baseline only when needed, and enforce evidence-driven work units, phase decision audits, and rollback-aware execution.

changes: Use an existing canonical PRD's directly confirmed product decisions as the preferred Product Authority Source.
Create fallback decisions.md only when suitable canonical PRD authority is unavailable, preventing duplicate product sources of truth.
Keep phase Product Decision Delta audits and engineering evidence gates while making authority-source selection explicit in plan.md.
